scene: The painted board lists whimsical transports departing across the frozen fairground.
picture: Side-view pixel art of a bustling fairground depot. On the far left stands the boy in his orange vest and kite, holding chestnuts. Left, a brass sleigh tram idles on rails. At centre, a glass-bottomed boat bobs at a pier. Right, a striped hot-air balloon basket waits tethered. Far right stands a station lamp.
